title: Agent Behavior Maps: Locating Agents by What They Would Do, Without Running Them
title_zh: 智能体行为地图：不运行智能体即可通过其可能的行为对其进行定位

paragraphs.en: LLM agents with similar success rates can follow different action sequences. An Agent Behavior Map represents LLM–harness combinations using centered action log-likelihoods on shared reference trajectories, without requiring new environment rollouts from the target agent. We derive error bounds relating squared coordinate distances to trajectory KL under explicit assumptions, and across eight cross-scored models the distances track the directly measured trajectory KL in rank order. Across 100 LLMs and four environments, ALFWorld-based coordinates support performance prediction and identify behavioral similarities. In ALFWorld, these similarities persist after controlling for success rates and model size, including across model families. As an extension, harness-component displacements approximately compose, with accuracy varying across components and environments.
paragraphs.zh: 成功率相近的大语言模型智能体可能会遵循不同的动作序列。 智能体行为图谱（Agent Behavior Map）通过在共享参考轨迹上计算居中的动作对数似然来表征大语言模型–运行框架（harness）组合，无需从目标智能体生成新的环境 rollout。 我们在明确假设下推导出误差界，将坐标距离的平方与轨迹 KL 散度联系起来，并且在八个交叉评分的模型上，这些距离在排序上与直接测量的轨迹 KL 散度保持一致。 在 100 个大语言模型和四个环境中，基于 ALFWorld 的坐标能够支持性能预测并识别行为相似性。 在 ALFWorld 中，即使控制成功率和模型规模之后，这些相似性依然存在，包括跨模型家族的情况。 作为扩展，运行框架组件的位移近似可叠加，其精度因组件和环境而异。

paragraphs.en: Comparing LLM agents is a matter not only of how often they succeed but also of how they act. Agents with similar success rates can differ in the tools they choose, the order of their actions, and how often they repeat an operation. Such behavior depends on the combination of the underlying LLM and the harness that manages history, planning, and reasoning ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ; Vats and Golev, 2026 ; Fan et al., 2026 ) . Running every combination in the environment reveals both performance and behavior, but each new agent to compare requires collecting new trajectories. This paper asks whether a representation that captures similarity of run-time behavior can be built without new environment runs of the target agent.
paragraphs.zh: 比较大型语言模型智能体，不仅在于它们成功的频率，还在于它们如何行动。成功率相近的智能体在所选工具、行动顺序以及重复某一操作的频率上可能各不相同。这种行为取决于底层 LLM 与管理历史、规划和推理的框架（harness）的组合（Zhang et al., 2026；Yao et al., 2026；Vats and Golev, 2026；Fan et al., 2026）。在环境中运行每一种组合可以同时揭示性能与行为，但每新增一个待比较的智能体，都需要收集新的轨迹。本文探讨的问题是：能否在不让目标智能体重新运行环境的情况下，构建一种能捕捉运行时行为相似性的表示。

paragraphs.en: When agents are compared by their log-likelihoods on shared reference trajectories, the difficulty is that the distribution of the histories on which the likelihoods are conditioned itself depends on the agent’s policy. The histories contained in the reference trajectories need not coincide with those that an agent reaches through its own actions. Whether similarity of action probabilities measured on shared histories corresponds to similarity of trajectory distributions and behavior at run time is therefore not obvious. How much of these on-policy properties can be captured by off-policy observations on fixed reference trajectories is the central question of this work.
paragraphs.zh: 当通过智能体在共享参考轨迹上的对数似然来比较它们时，难点在于似然所条件化的历史分布本身就取决于该智能体的策略。 参考轨迹中包含的历史未必与智能体通过自身行动所达到的历史一致。 因此，在共享历史上测得的动作概率相似性是否对应于运行时的轨迹分布和行为的相似性，并不明显。 这些在策略特性中有多少能够通过对固定参考轨迹的离策略观测所捕捉，是本工作的核心问题。

paragraphs.en: Language model maps, which vectorize log-likelihoods on shared texts, represent the relations between models in a common coordinate space ( Oyama et al., 2025 ) . Their extension to prompt–response distributions has examined performance prediction from conditional log-likelihoods and the approximate additivity of the coordinate displacements caused by prompt changes ( Oyama et al., 2026 ) . This paper applies the framework to agents that interact sequentially with an environment and answers the question above with theory and experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型图通过对共享文本上的对数似然进行向量化，在公共坐标空间中表示模型之间的关系（Oyama et al., 2025）。 其向提示–响应分布的扩展已经研究了基于条件对数似然的性能预测，以及提示变化所导致的坐标位移的近似可加性（Oyama et al., 2026）。 本文将该框架应用于与环境进行序列交互的智能体，并通过理论和实验回答上述问题。

paragraphs.en: An Agent Behavior Map treats each agent as a pair of an LLM and a harness. Each agent rebuilds its input with its own harness from the shared external history in the reference trajectories, namely the task, the observations, and the past actions. The recorded actions are teacher-forced under this input, and the resulting log-likelihood vector is centered to give the agent’s coordinates. Because the reference trajectories are reused, the coordinates of a new agent can be computed without collecting any additional environment trajectories from it. Figure 1 shows an example in which agents that are close in these coordinates take similar action sequences when run. We validate the representation from two angles.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体行为图将每个智能体视为一个 LLM 与一个 harness 的配对。 每个智能体使用自己的 harness，根据参考轨迹中的共享外部历史（即任务、观测和过去的动作）重建其输入。 在此输入下对记录的动作进行教师强制，并对得到的对数似然向量进行中心化，从而给出该智能体的坐标。 由于参考轨迹被重复使用，新智能体的坐标可以在不从其收集任何额外环境轨迹的情况下计算得出。 图 1 展示了一个示例，其中在这些坐标上彼此接近的智能体在运行时会采取相似的动作序列。 我们从两个角度验证这种表示。

sents.en: We validate the representation from two angles.

paragraphs.en: Theoretical and empirical relation to the trajectory distribution (§ 2 , § 3.1 ). Under assumptions on the locality of the two policies and on the mismatch with the reference distribution, we derive error bounds that relate squared coordinate distances to the KL divergence between trajectory distributions. The error decomposes into local approximation, reference mismatch, centering, and finite samples, and the decomposition shows how the step-level and trajectory-level representations differ in their dependence on trajectory length. In a cross-scoring experiment with eight models, we compare the coordinate distances with the directly measured trajectory KL, the target itself, and find a high rank correlation.
paragraphs.zh: 与轨迹分布之间的理论和经验关系（§ 2，§ 3.1）。 在对两个策略的局部性以及与参考分布的不匹配程度做出假设的条件下，我们推导出了误差界，将平方坐标距离与轨迹分布之间的 KL 散度联系起来。 该误差分解为局部近似、参考不匹配、中心化以及有限样本四个部分，且该分解表明步级表示与轨迹级表示在对轨迹长度的依赖方式上有所不同。 在一项包含八个模型的交叉评分实验中，我们将坐标距离与直接测得的轨迹 KL（即目标本身）进行比较，并发现了较高的秩相关。

paragraphs.en: Validation on performance and behavior (§ 3.2 , § 3.3 ). We apply a common harness to 100 LLMs and evaluate coordinates built from ALFWorld reference trajectories alone on ALFWorld, TextWorld, BFCL, and MiniWoB++. Besides predicting the success rates of unevaluated models from the evaluation results of the others, we ask whether neighbors on the map generate similar action sequences. In ALFWorld in particular, the similarity of action sequences remains when compared with neighbors chosen by success rate or by size, and when the candidates are restricted to models of other families. These results support the view that the coordinates carry behavioral information that neither performance level nor model family explains. The accuracy of performance prediction and the strength of behavioral similarity among neighbors, however, depend on the environment and the measure.
paragraphs.zh: 对性能与行为的验证（§ 3.2、§ 3.3）。 我们将一个通用测试框架应用于 100 个大语言模型，并评估仅由 ALFWorld 参考轨迹构建的坐标在 ALFWorld、TextWorld、BFCL 和 MiniWoB++ 上的表现。 除了根据其他模型的评估结果预测未评估模型的成功率之外，我们还探究地图上的近邻是否会生成相似的动作序列。 尤其在 ALFWorld 中，当与按成功率或按规模选出的近邻进行比较，以及当候选模型被限制为其他模型家族的模型时，动作序列的相似性依然存在。 这些结果支持如下观点：坐标所承载的行为信息既无法由性能水平解释，也无法由模型家族解释。 然而，性能预测的准确性以及近邻之间行为相似性的强度，取决于具体的环境和度量方式。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we represent the addition of a harness component as a displacement on the map and ask whether such displacements add up within an LLM (§ 4 ). Comparison with measured coordinates shows approximate additivity, with an accuracy that depends on the component and the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们将一个测试框架（harness）组件的加入表示为地图上的一个位移，并探究这类位移在大型语言模型（LLM）内部是否会相互叠加（§ 4）。 与实测坐标的比较表明这种叠加近似成立，其精度取决于具体组件和运行环境。

paragraphs.en: This section fixes the harness to a standard configuration (BASE: a history window of the last four steps, no planning, direct action; § 4.1 ) and places each LLM as one point. The question is what the coordinates capture about an agent. LM maps showed a correlation between coordinates and downstream performance ( Oyama et al., 2025 ) . We answer with three quantities: the target itself, the KL between the trajectory distributions of the agents when run (§ 3.1 ); one projection of it, the success rate (§ 3.2 ); and the behavior itself when run (§ 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 本节将测试框架固定为标准配置（BASE：最近四步的历史窗口、无规划、直接行动；§ 4.1），并把每个 LLM 作为一个点。 问题在于这些坐标捕捉了关于智能体的什么信息。 LM 地图显示了坐标与下游性能之间的相关性（Oyama et al., 2025）。 我们用三个量来回答：目标本身，即智能体运行时轨迹分布之间的 KL 散度（§ 3.1）；它的一个投影，即成功率（§ 3.2）；以及运行时的行为本身（§ 3.3）。

paragraphs.en: Theorem 1 applies only in the local regime of small ε \varepsilon , that is, to nearly identical policies, whereas actual pairs of models may be far apart. We therefore check empirically whether the distances track the trajectory KL outside that regime, and which version, step or trajectory, tracks it better. In the bounds, the step version is favored by a factor of order T T (Table 1 ); we ask whether this advantage shows in the data. Measuring the trajectory KL directly requires rollouts of every model and O ⁡ ( n 2 ) O(n^{2}) cross-scoring, so we use eight models: each solves a common set of ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) train tasks, every model scores every trajectory, and the cross-scoring gives K sym K_{\mathrm{sym}} for the ( 8 2 ) = 28 \binom{8}{2}=28 pairs. The distances use the pooled trajectories of the eight models as the common reference (Appendix B.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 定理 1 仅适用于小 ε \varepsilon 的局部区域，即近似相同的策略，而实际的模型对可能相距甚远。 因此，我们通过实验检验在该区域之外这些距离是否仍能追踪轨迹 KL，以及步级版本和轨迹版本哪一个追踪得更好。 在这些界中，步级版本享有量级为 T T 的因子优势（表 1）；我们探究这一优势是否会在数据中体现出来。 直接测量轨迹 KL 需要对每个模型进行 rollout 以及 O ⁡ ( n 2 ) O(n^{2}) 的交叉评分，因此我们使用八个模型：每个模型求解一组共同的 ALFWorld（Shridhar et al., 2021）训练任务，每个模型对每条轨迹进行评分，交叉评分给出这 ( 8 2 ) = 28 \binom{8}{2}=28 个模型对的 K sym K_{\mathrm{sym}}。 这些距离以八个模型的汇聚轨迹作为共同参考（附录 B.1）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows the result (numbers in Table 6 , Appendix B.2 ). The centered step estimate T ¯ 2 ​ D ^ S 2 \tfrac{\bar{T}}{2}\hat{D}_{S}^{2} correlates with K sym K_{\mathrm{sym}} at Pearson r = 0.90 r=0.90 and Spearman ρ = 0.95 \rho=0.95 , and the trajectory estimate 1 2 ​ D ^ τ 2 \tfrac{1}{2}\hat{D}_{\tau}^{2} at 0.86 0.86 / 0.94 0.94 : distances measured without running the agents preserve the order of the trajectory KL measured by running them. Two trends are consistent with the bounds (Appendix B.2 ): the RMSE of the trajectory version is an order of magnitude larger than that of the step version, as the orders T T versus T 2 T^{2} predict, and adding reference trajectories shrinks only the sampling error while the approximation error remains. Centering, although it adds a term to the bound, raises the correlation and lowers the RMSE for both versions. Reading the distances between the eight models from the 100-model map of § 3.2 instead, with different reference trajectories and no grammar constraint, gives r = 0.86 r=0.86 and ρ = 0.88 \rho=0.88 (Appendix B.2 ). Both versions overestimate the measured KL in level, by a median factor of 7.5 for the step version and 74 for the trajectory version (Appendix B.2 ), so in what follows we use the distances only as a proxy for the order of the KL, and we use the step version.

paragraphs.en: From here on we use 100 open-weight LLMs. The reference trajectories are 500 trajectories with 10,388 steps, generated by two models (Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) and Gemma4-E4B ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) ) on 250 ALFWorld train tasks; every model scores them, and its centered step coordinates are computed from these scores. Only the two generators ran the reference trajectories; the other models only score them. Success rates and action sequences are obtained by running each model itself on different tasks, so the material for the coordinates and the material for the evaluation do not overlap. Scoring uses raw log-likelihoods without the grammar constraint; rescoring with the constraint barely moves the coordinates (Appendix B.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 从这里开始，我们使用 100 个开放权重大语言模型。 参考轨迹是 500 条共 10,388 步的轨迹，由两个模型（Qwen3.8-27B（Qwen Team, 2026b）和 Gemma4-E4B（Gemma Team, 2026））在 250 个 ALFWorld 训练任务上生成；每个模型对它们进行评分，其中心化的步坐标由这些分数计算得出。 只有两个生成器模型运行了参考轨迹；其他模型只对它们进行评分。 成功率和动作序列是通过让每个模型自身在不同任务上运行获得的，因此用于计算坐标的素材和用于评估的素材互不重叠。 评分使用不带语法约束的原始对数似然；加上该约束重新评分后，坐标几乎不变（附录 B.1）。

paragraphs.en: Can the downstream success rate of a model that has only computed likelihoods on the reference trajectories, and has never been run in the environment, be predicted from its coordinates? We hold out one model at a time and predict it from the remaining 99. The downstream tasks are 50 ALFWorld valid_unseen tasks, the environment of the coordinates, and 50 tasks each from different environments , TextWorld ( Côté et al., 2018 ) , BFCL ( Patil et al., 2025 ) , and MiniWoB++ ( Shi et al., 2017 ; Liu et al., 2018 ) , plus the averages over the four benchmarks and over the three other environments (Appendix B.3 ). The baselines use only information available without running : a regression on the log parameter count (size), the mean success rate of the same family (family), and a regression on the mean log-likelihood ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell} (the component removed by centering). On the coordinate side we use kNN, Ridge ( Hoerl and Kennard, 1970 ) , and Ridge with size as a covariate, with hyperparameters chosen by inner leave-one-out (Appendix B.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于一个仅在参考轨迹上计算了似然、从未在环境中运行过的模型，能否根据其坐标预测其下游成功率？ 我们每次留出一个模型，用其余99个模型来预测它。 下游任务是50个ALFWorld valid_unseen任务（即坐标所在环境），以及来自不同环境的各50个任务：TextWorld（Côté et al., 2018）、BFCL（Patil et al., 2025）和MiniWoB++（Shi et al., 2017；Liu et al., 2018），外加四个基准上的平均值和另外三个环境上的平均值（附录B.3）。 基线仅使用无需运行即可获得的信息：基于对数参数量（规模）的回归、同一家族的平均成功率（家族），以及基于平均对数似然 ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell}（即中心化所去除的分量）的回归。 在坐标一侧，我们使用kNN、Ridge（Hoerl and Kennard, 1970），以及将规模作为协变量的Ridge，超参数通过内部留一法（附录B.3）选择。

sents.en: We hold out one model at a time and predict it from the remaining 99.
sents.zh: 我们每次留出一个模型，用其余99个模型来预测它。

sents.en: The downstream tasks are 50 ALFWorld valid_unseen tasks, the environment of the coordinates, and 50 tasks each from different environments , TextWorld ( Côté et al., 2018 ) , BFCL ( Patil et al., 2025 ) , and MiniWoB++ ( Shi et al., 2017 ; Liu et al., 2018 ) , plus the averages over the four benchmarks and over the three other environments (Appendix B.3 ).
sents.zh: 下游任务是50个ALFWorld valid_unseen任务（即坐标所在环境），以及来自不同环境的各50个任务：TextWorld（Côté et al., 2018）、BFCL（Patil et al., 2025）和MiniWoB++（Shi et al., 2017；Liu et al., 2018），外加四个基准上的平均值和另外三个环境上的平均值（附录B.3）。

sents.en: The baselines use only information available without running : a regression on the log parameter count (size), the mean success rate of the same family (family), and a regression on the mean log-likelihood ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell} (the component removed by centering).
sents.zh: 基线仅使用无需运行即可获得的信息：基于对数参数量（规模）的回归、同一家族的平均成功率（家族），以及基于平均对数似然 ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell}（即中心化所去除的分量）的回归。

sents.en: On the coordinate side we use kNN, Ridge ( Hoerl and Kennard, 1970 ) , and Ridge with size as a covariate, with hyperparameters chosen by inner leave-one-out (Appendix B.3 ).
sents.zh: 在坐标一侧，我们使用kNN、Ridge（Hoerl and Kennard, 1970），以及将规模作为协变量的Ridge，超参数通过内部留一法（附录B.3）选择。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports Pearson r r . In ALFWorld, the environment of the coordinates, kNN reaches r = 0.88 r=0.88 against 0.63 0.63 for size (the bootstrap interval of the difference excludes zero): the success rate of a model that has only run forward passes on the 500 reference trajectories is predicted from the results of the other 99 models with an RMSE of 9 points on the 50 valid_unseen tasks. In the other environments, all three coordinate methods beat size on BFCL ( 0.65 0.65 – 0.69 0.69 versus 0.48 0.48 ) and TextWorld ( 0.76 0.76 – 0.78 0.78 versus 0.71 0.71 ); on MiniWoB++ size is stronger ( 0.64 0.64 versus 0.56 0.56 for Ridge), although a quantity built from likelihoods alone still captures this much. Combining size and coordinates matches size on MiniWoB++ ( 0.63 0.63 ) and improves the four-benchmark average to 0.83 0.83 (size 0.74 0.74 ) and the three-environment average to 0.81 0.81 ( 0.72 0.72 ). Since ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell} is weak and the coordinates are strong, what matters is not the overall level of the likelihood but its shape : which actions a model finds natural in which states. A success rate, however, is only one projection of behavior when run; we ask next whether that is all the coordinates capture.
paragraphs.zh: 表2报告了Pearson r r。 在ALFWorld中，比较坐标环境，kNN达到 r = 0.88 r=0.88，而size为 0.63 0.63（该差异的bootstrap区间不包含零）：一个仅在500条参考轨迹上运行过前向传播的模型，其成功率可以通过其他99个模型的结果来预测，在50个valid_unseen任务上的RMSE为9个百分点。 在其他环境中，所有三种坐标方法在BFCL（ 0.65 0.65 – 0.69 0.69 对比 0.48 0.48 ）和TextWorld（ 0.76 0.76 – 0.78 0.78 对比 0.71 0.71 ）上都胜过size；在MiniWoB++上size更强（ 0.64 0.64 对比Ridge的 0.56 0.56 ），不过仅由似然构建的量仍能捕捉到这么多信息。 将size与坐标结合后在MiniWoB++上与size持平（ 0.63 0.63 ），并将四项基准的平均值提升至 0.83 0.83（size为 0.74 0.74 ），三项环境的平均值提升至 0.81 0.81（ 0.72 0.72 ）。 由于 ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell} 较弱而坐标较强，重要的不是似然的整体水平，而是其形状：即模型在哪些状态下认为哪些动作是自然的。 然而，成功率只是运行时行为的一个投影；我们接下来要问的是，坐标是否仅捕捉到了这些。

paragraphs.en: In § 3.2 , models that are close in coordinates had similar success rates. Do neighbors also share their behavior when run? Behavior can only be measured as a distance between a pair of models, so the question becomes whether the behavioral distance from a model to its coordinate neighbors is smaller than its distance to the remaining models. We look at neighbors rather than at the correlation over all pairs because the guarantee covers only close pairs (§ 2.4 ). Coordinate neighbors are compared with two kinds of neighbors. The first are neighbors chosen by size, family, or ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell} , which, as in Table 2 , use only information available without running. The second are neighbors chosen by the measured success rate on that benchmark, a reference that is available only after running. Agents with the same success rate do not necessarily solve tasks in the same way, so the gap to the second kind shows what the coordinates capture beyond closeness in performance.
paragraphs.zh: 在 §3.2 中，坐标相近的模型具有相近的成功率。 相邻的模型在运行时是否也表现出相似的行为？ 行为只能以一对模型之间的距离来度量，因此问题就变成：模型到其坐标近邻的行为距离是否小于它到其余模型的距离。 我们考察近邻而非所有模型对之间的相关性，因为该保证仅涵盖相近的模型对（§2.4）。 坐标近邻与两类近邻进行比较。 第一类是按规模、家族或 ℓ¯ 选择的近邻，如表 2 所示，它们只使用无需运行即可获得的信息。 第二类是按该基准上测得的成功率选择的近邻，这一参照只有在运行之后才能获得。 成功率相同的智能体不一定以相同的方式解决任务，因此与第二类近邻的差距可以显示坐标在性能相近之外还能捕捉到什么。

sents.en: In § 3.2 , models that are close in coordinates had similar success rates.
sents.zh: 在 §3.2 中，坐标相近的模型具有相近的成功率。

sents.zh: 相邻的模型在运行时是否也表现出相似的行为？

paragraphs.en: We use the action sequences that each model itself produced with the BASE harness: ALFWorld valid_unseen (50 tasks), the environment of the coordinates, and the other environments TextWorld (50), BFCL multi_turn (25), and MiniWoB++ (50), all for the 100 models. The behavioral distance between two models is the distance between their trajectories on the same task, averaged over tasks. Since similar behavior is not a single number, we measure it in four aspects from coarse to fine (definitions in Appendix B.4 ):
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用各模型自身在 BASE 框架下产生的动作序列：ALFWorld valid_unseen（50 个任务）、坐标环境，以及 TextWorld（50）、BFCL multi_turn（25）和 MiniWoB++（50）等其他环境，全部针对这 100 个模型。 两个模型之间的行为距离是它们在同一任务上的轨迹之间的距离，并对所有任务取平均。 由于相似行为并非单一数字，我们从粗到细在四个方面对其进行度量（定义见附录 B.4）：

sents.en: We use the action sequences that each model itself produced with the BASE harness: ALFWorld valid_unseen (50 tasks), the environment of the coordinates, and the other environments TextWorld (50), BFCL multi_turn (25), and MiniWoB++ (50), all for the 100 models.
sents.zh: 我们使用各模型自身在 BASE 框架下产生的动作序列：ALFWorld valid_unseen（50 个任务）、坐标环境，以及 TextWorld（50）、BFCL multi_turn（25）和 MiniWoB++（50）等其他环境，全部针对这 100 个模型。

sents.en: The behavioral distance between two models is the distance between their trajectories on the same task, averaged over tasks.
sents.zh: 两个模型之间的行为距离是它们在同一任务上的轨迹之间的距离，并对所有任务取平均。

sents.en: Since similar behavior is not a single number, we measure it in four aspects from coarse to fine (definitions in Appendix B.4 ):
sents.zh: 由于相似行为并非单一数字，我们从粗到细在四个方面对其进行度量（定义见附录 B.4）：

paragraphs.en: Composition (which actions are used how often, ignoring order): Jensen–Shannon distance between the distributions of action types ( Endres and Schindelin, 2003 ) (type JS)
paragraphs.zh: 组成（各类动作被使用的频率，忽略顺序）：动作类型分布之间的 Jensen–Shannon 距离（ Endres and Schindelin, 2003 ）（类型 JS）

paragraphs.en: Global (agreement of the whole action sequence): normalized Levenshtein distance ( Levenshtein, 1966 ; Rabanser et al., 2026 ) (edit distance)
paragraphs.zh: 全局（整个动作序列的一致性）：归一化编辑距离（normalized Levenshtein distance）（Levenshtein, 1966; Rabanser et al., 2026）

paragraphs.en: Local (what follows a given action): Jaccard distance between the sets of action 2-grams (2-gram)
paragraphs.zh: 局部性（执行某个给定动作之后）：动作 2-gram 集合之间的 Jaccard 距离 (2-gram)

paragraphs.en: Early (whether the same first move is made from the same state): disagreement rate of the first action from the same initial state ( Bouchard and Chauhan, 2026 ; Gonuguntla, 2026 ) (first action)
paragraphs.zh: 早期（相同状态是否做出相同的第一步）：同一初始状态下第一个动作的分歧率（Bouchard and Chauhan, 2026；Gonuguntla, 2026）（首个动作）

paragraphs.en: The difference in success rate is measured in the same form, which puts the results of § 3.2 on the same scale. The effect size for a model’s five coordinate neighbors is the mean behavioral distance to the remaining models minus the mean distance to the neighbors, divided by the standard deviation over all pairs (positive: neighbors more similar). Figure 1 (c) applies the same definition to the k k -th nearest model alone, in coordinates and in size, averaged over the 100 models and the four aspects.
paragraphs.zh: 成功率的差异以相同形式度量，使 § 3.2 的结果处于同一尺度上。 某个模型的五个坐标邻居的效应量定义为：与其余模型的平均行为距离减去与邻居的平均距离，再除以所有模型对上的标准差（正值表示邻居更相似）。 图 1（c）将同样的定义单独应用于第 k 个最近的模型，包括坐标和大小两个方面，并在 100 个模型和四个维度上取平均。

sents.en: The difference in success rate is measured in the same form, which puts the results of § 3.2 on the same scale.
sents.zh: 成功率的差异以相同形式度量，使 § 3.2 的结果处于同一尺度上。

sents.en: The effect size for a model’s five coordinate neighbors is the mean behavioral distance to the remaining models minus the mean distance to the neighbors, divided by the standard deviation over all pairs (positive: neighbors more similar).
sents.zh: 某个模型的五个坐标邻居的效应量定义为：与其余模型的平均行为距离减去与邻居的平均距离，再除以所有模型对上的标准差（正值表示邻居更相似）。

sents.en: Figure 1 (c) applies the same definition to the k k -th nearest model alone, in coordinates and in size, averaged over the 100 models and the four aspects.
sents.zh: 图 1（c）将同样的定义单独应用于第 k 个最近的模型，包括坐标和大小两个方面，并在 100 个模型和四个维度上取平均。

paragraphs.en: The five coordinate neighbors not only have similar success rates ( 0.39 0.39 – 0.61 0.61 ) but also behave alike on all four benchmarks (Table 3 ). The effect is roughly twice that of size neighbors (edit distance on ALFWorld 0.88 0.88 versus 0.40 0.40 ; 2-gram on MiniWoB++ 0.50 0.50 versus 0.27 0.27 ), and ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell} neighbors are weak ( 0.03 0.03 – 0.20 0.20 ). Family is a stronger competitor than size: coordinates exceed it on ALFWorld, TextWorld, and MiniWoB++ (except for the first action on TextWorld) and tie with it on BFCL. The effect remains when the coordinate neighbors are restricted to other families (edit distance on ALFWorld 0.60 0.60 ), so it is not produced by same-family dependence. Similarity decreases with rank: the first coordinate neighbor is the most similar and the effect returns to the overall mean around rank 30, whereas size neighbors are nearly flat beyond the first (Figure 1 (c)). The divergence position and the profile of idiosyncrasies show the same pattern, while for the success pattern, neighbors chosen by family or size are about as close as or closer than coordinate neighbors (Appendix B.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 五个坐标邻居不仅有相近的成功率（0.39–0.61），而且在全部四个基准上表现相似（表3）。 其效应大约是规模邻居的两倍（ALFWorld 上的编辑距离 0.88 对 0.40；MiniWoB++ 上的 2-gram 0.50 对 0.27），而 ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell} 邻居的效应很弱（0.03–0.20）。 家族是比规模更强的竞争者：坐标在 ALFWorld、TextWorld 和 MiniWoB++ 上超过它（TextWorld 上除第一个动作外），并在 BFCL 上与其持平。 当把坐标邻居限制为其他家族时，该效应依然存在（ALFWorld 上的编辑距离 0.60），因此它并非由同家族依赖所产生。 相似度随排名递减：第一个坐标邻居最为相似，其效应在大约第 30 名处回归到总体均值，而规模邻居在第一个之后几乎持平（图1(c)）。 分歧位置和特异性的轮廓呈现出相同的模式，而对于成功模式而言，按家族或规模选取的邻居与坐标邻居一样接近甚至更接近（附录 B.4）。

sents.en: The five coordinate neighbors not only have similar success rates ( 0.39 0.39 – 0.61 0.61 ) but also behave alike on all four benchmarks (Table 3 ).
sents.zh: 五个坐标邻居不仅有相近的成功率（0.39–0.61），而且在全部四个基准上表现相似（表3）。

sents.en: The effect is roughly twice that of size neighbors (edit distance on ALFWorld 0.88 0.88 versus 0.40 0.40 ; 2-gram on MiniWoB++ 0.50 0.50 versus 0.27 0.27 ), and ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell} neighbors are weak ( 0.03 0.03 – 0.20 0.20 ).
sents.zh: 其效应大约是规模邻居的两倍（ALFWorld 上的编辑距离 0.88 对 0.40；MiniWoB++ 上的 2-gram 0.50 对 0.27），而 ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell} 邻居的效应很弱（0.03–0.20）。

sents.en: Family is a stronger competitor than size: coordinates exceed it on ALFWorld, TextWorld, and MiniWoB++ (except for the first action on TextWorld) and tie with it on BFCL.
sents.zh: 家族是比规模更强的竞争者：坐标在 ALFWorld、TextWorld 和 MiniWoB++ 上超过它（TextWorld 上除第一个动作外），并在 BFCL 上与其持平。

sents.en: The effect remains when the coordinate neighbors are restricted to other families (edit distance on ALFWorld 0.60 0.60 ), so it is not produced by same-family dependence.
sents.zh: 当把坐标邻居限制为其他家族时，该效应依然存在（ALFWorld 上的编辑距离 0.60），因此它并非由同家族依赖所产生。

sents.en: Similarity decreases with rank: the first coordinate neighbor is the most similar and the effect returns to the overall mean around rank 30, whereas size neighbors are nearly flat beyond the first (Figure 1 (c)).
sents.zh: 相似度随排名递减：第一个坐标邻居最为相似，其效应在大约第 30 名处回归到总体均值，而规模邻居在第一个之后几乎持平（图1(c)）。

sents.en: The divergence position and the profile of idiosyncrasies show the same pattern, while for the success pattern, neighbors chosen by family or size are about as close as or closer than coordinate neighbors (Appendix B.4 ).
sents.zh: 分歧位置和特异性的轮廓呈现出相同的模式，而对于成功模式而言，按家族或规模选取的邻居与坐标邻居一样接近甚至更接近（附录 B.4）。

paragraphs.en: In ALFWorld, the environment of the coordinates, coordinate neighbors behave more alike than neighbors chosen by the measured success rate in all four aspects ( † \dagger in Table 3 ); in the other environments the two are roughly on a par, with coordinates significantly closer only for composition on TextWorld and MiniWoB++ and for the first action on MiniWoB++. We also regress out performance and size (Appendix B.4 ): because strong models may converge on the shortest procedures, we regress each pair’s behavioral distance on the difference in success rate, the pair’s mean success rate and its square, and the difference in log parameter count, and measure the neighbor effect on the residuals. In ALFWorld the effect remains (edit distance 0.61 0.61 , 2-gram 0.68 0.68 ) and stays positive when the candidates are restricted to other families ( 0.31 0.31 , 0.31 0.31 ); in the other environments it is weak, remains mainly in the local and early measures, and for some measures vanishes or changes sign. This linear control shows only that an association remains that the observed success rates and sizes do not explain. That the coordinates are built from the likelihood of the next action in a fixed state is consistent with the effect remaining in the local and early measures.
paragraphs.zh: 在 ALFWorld 中，坐标的邻居在所有四个方面都比按测得成功率选取的邻居表现得更加相似（表 3 中的 † \dagger ）；在其他环境中两者大致相当，只有 TextWorld 和 MiniWoB++ 上的组合以及 MiniWoB++ 上的首个动作中坐标才显著更接近。 我们还回归掉了性能和规模的影响（附录 B.4）：由于强模型可能收敛于最短的程序，我们将每对智能体的行为距离对成功率之差、该对智能体的平均成功率及其平方、以及对数参数量之差进行回归，并在残差上度量邻居效应。 在 ALFWorld 中该效应仍然存在（编辑距离 0.61 0.61 ，2-gram 0.68 0.68 ），且当候选限制为其他家族时仍保持为正（ 0.31 0.31 ， 0.31 0.31 ）；在其他环境中该效应较弱，主要存在于局部和早期度量中，并且对某些度量会消失或变号。 这一线性对照只能表明存在一种观测到的成功率和规模无法解释的关联。 坐标是基于固定状态下下一动作的似然构建的，这与该效应在局部和早期度量中依然存在的事实相符。

sents.en: In ALFWorld, the environment of the coordinates, coordinate neighbors behave more alike than neighbors chosen by the measured success rate in all four aspects ( † \dagger in Table 3 ); in the other environments the two are roughly on a par, with coordinates significantly closer only for composition on TextWorld and MiniWoB++ and for the first action on MiniWoB++.
sents.zh: 在 ALFWorld 中，坐标的邻居在所有四个方面都比按测得成功率选取的邻居表现得更加相似（表 3 中的 † \dagger ）；在其他环境中两者大致相当，只有 TextWorld 和 MiniWoB++ 上的组合以及 MiniWoB++ 上的首个动作中坐标才显著更接近。

sents.en: We also regress out performance and size (Appendix B.4 ): because strong models may converge on the shortest procedures, we regress each pair’s behavioral distance on the difference in success rate, the pair’s mean success rate and its square, and the difference in log parameter count, and measure the neighbor effect on the residuals.
sents.zh: 我们还回归掉了性能和规模的影响（附录 B.4）：由于强模型可能收敛于最短的程序，我们将每对智能体的行为距离对成功率之差、该对智能体的平均成功率及其平方、以及对数参数量之差进行回归，并在残差上度量邻居效应。

sents.en: In ALFWorld the effect remains (edit distance 0.61 0.61 , 2-gram 0.68 0.68 ) and stays positive when the candidates are restricted to other families ( 0.31 0.31 , 0.31 0.31 ); in the other environments it is weak, remains mainly in the local and early measures, and for some measures vanishes or changes sign.

sents.en: This linear control shows only that an association remains that the observed success rates and sizes do not explain.
sents.zh: 这一线性对照只能表明存在一种观测到的成功率和规模无法解释的关联。

sents.en: That the coordinates are built from the likelihood of the next action in a fixed state is consistent with the effect remaining in the local and early measures.
sents.zh: 坐标是基于固定状态下下一动作的似然构建的，这与该效应在局部和早期度量中依然存在的事实相符。

paragraphs.en: Section 3 fixed the harness; this section fixes the LLM, varies the harness, and asks what structure the map has with respect to harnesses . A harness combines components for context management, planning, and acting. If adding a component appears as a displacement within an LLM and these displacements add up, the map reads as the position of the LLM plus a sum of component vectors, and the coordinates of an unscored combination follow from the scores of single components. We test whether the approximate additivity observed for prompt changes in LM maps ( Oyama et al., 2026 ) also holds for agent harnesses (§ 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 节固定了测试框架；本节则固定大语言模型，变换测试框架，并询问该地图相对于测试框架具有何种结构。 一个测试框架组合了用于上下文管理、规划和行动的组件。 如果添加一个组件表现为大语言模型内部的一次位移，且这些位移可以累加，那么地图就可以读作大语言模型的位置加上各组件向量之和，而未评分组合的坐标便可由单个组件的分数推得。 我们检验在语言模型地图中针对提示词变化所观察到的近似可加性（Oyama et al., 2026）是否同样适用于智能体测试框架（§ 4.2）。

paragraphs.en: A harness splits the rule C i C_{i} that builds the LLM’s input from the external history h t h_{t} (§ 2.1 ) into three slots.

paragraphs.en: Context management (which part of the history is shown): windowed passes the initial observation and the last four steps verbatim; retrieve adds past steps retrieved for their relevance; summarize replaces old history with a structured summary.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文管理（显示历史的哪一部分）：windowed 逐字传递初始观察和最后四个步骤；retrieve 添加根据相关性检索到的过往步骤；summarize 用结构化摘要替换旧的历史记录。

paragraphs.en: Planning (whether a plan is rewritten before acting): none / replan.
paragraphs.zh: 规划（在行动前是否重写计划）：无 / 重新规划。

paragraphs.en: Acting (whether free-form reasoning is written before the action): direct / think.
paragraphs.zh: 行动（是否在行动之前写下自由格式的推理）：direct / think。

paragraphs.en: System instructions, tool definitions, and the initial observation are shared by all harnesses; plans and reasoning enter only the current step’s input, so the external history consists of actions and observations only and every harness builds its input from the same h t h_{t} , both when running and when scoring. The 3 × 2 × 2 = 12 3\times 2\times 2=12 combinations include BASE (windowed/none/direct), four single-component harnesses that add one component to BASE, and seven composed harnesses that add two or more (specifications in Appendix C.1 ).

paragraphs.en: For two-component compositions, the median cosine over the 60 cases (12 LLMs × \times 5 compositions) is 0.90 0.90 and the median norm ratio 0.98 0.98 , so the sum roughly matches in direction and length. The agreement varies by composition: retrieve with planning or reasoning agrees best (cosine 0.97 0.97 / 0.94 0.94 , relative error 0.25 0.25 / 0.34 0.34 ), compositions with summarize keep the direction but deviate more (cosine 0.91 0.91 / 0.87 0.87 ), and replan + think is weakest (cosine 0.81 0.81 , norm ratio 0.74 0.74 : the measured displacement is shorter than predicted). Three-component compositions reach cosine 0.82 0.82 and norm ratio 0.87 0.87 (median over 2 × 12 2\times 12 cases). On ALFWorld and SWE-Bench (6 LLMs) the agreement weakens to median two-component cosines of 0.63 0.63 and 0.81 0.81 (Table 12 ). Additivity thus depends on the components and the environment, but for context management combined with planning or reasoning, the direction and magnitude of the composed displacement can be approximated from single-component displacements.

paragraphs.en: LM maps ( Oyama et al., 2025 ) place models in a common coordinate system by their log-likelihoods on fixed texts and have been extended to prompt–response distributions ( Oyama et al., 2026 ) ; other works embed models by their outputs or correctness ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Yax et al., 2025 ; Zhuang et al., 2025 ) . All of them address static LMs. In reinforcement learning, policies are compared by their actions on a fixed set of states ( Parker-Holder et al., 2020 ; Pacchiano et al., 2020 ; Konyushkova et al., 2021 ) . We extend LM maps to closed-loop agents and quantify the cost of measuring on fixed trajectories as the term λ \lambda , which accumulates over steps like the compounding error of imitation learning ( Ross and Bagnell, 2010 ; Ross et al., 2011 ) . Predicting performance from scores on cheaper benchmarks ( Ruan et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2026 ) shares our goal but needs the target model’s scores, whereas our coordinates need neither scores nor environment runs.
paragraphs.zh: LM 映射（Oyama et al., 2025）通过模型在固定文本上的对数似然将它们置于一个共同坐标系中，并已被扩展到提示–响应分布（Oyama et al., 2026）；其他工作则根据模型的输出或正确性对其进行嵌入（Wu et al., 2026；Yax et al., 2025；Zhuang et al., 2025）。 它们都只针对静态 LM。 在强化学习中，策略通过其在固定状态集上的动作来进行比较（Parker-Holder et al., 2020；Pacchiano et al., 2020；Konyushkova et al., 2021）。 我们将 LM 映射扩展到闭环智能体，并将基于固定轨迹进行度量的代价量化为 λ \lambda 项，该项随步数累积，类似于模仿学习的复合误差（Ross and Bagnell, 2010；Ross et al., 2011）。 从更便宜的基准上的分数来预测性能（Ruan et al., 2024；Song et al., 2026）与我们的目标一致，但需要目标模型的分数，而我们的坐标既不需要分数也不需要环境运行。

sents.en: LM maps ( Oyama et al., 2025 ) place models in a common coordinate system by their log-likelihoods on fixed texts and have been extended to prompt–response distributions ( Oyama et al., 2026 ) ; other works embed models by their outputs or correctness ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Yax et al., 2025 ; Zhuang et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: LM 映射（Oyama et al., 2025）通过模型在固定文本上的对数似然将它们置于一个共同坐标系中，并已被扩展到提示–响应分布（Oyama et al., 2026）；其他工作则根据模型的输出或正确性对其进行嵌入（Wu et al., 2026；Yax et al., 2025；Zhuang et al., 2025）。

sents.en: All of them address static LMs.
sents.zh: 它们都只针对静态 LM。

sents.en: In reinforcement learning, policies are compared by their actions on a fixed set of states ( Parker-Holder et al., 2020 ; Pacchiano et al., 2020 ; Konyushkova et al., 2021 ) .
sents.zh: 在强化学习中，策略通过其在固定状态集上的动作来进行比较（Parker-Holder et al., 2020；Pacchiano et al., 2020；Konyushkova et al., 2021）。

sents.en: We extend LM maps to closed-loop agents and quantify the cost of measuring on fixed trajectories as the term λ \lambda , which accumulates over steps like the compounding error of imitation learning ( Ross and Bagnell, 2010 ; Ross et al., 2011 ) .
sents.zh: 我们将 LM 映射扩展到闭环智能体，并将基于固定轨迹进行度量的代价量化为 λ \lambda 项，该项随步数累积，类似于模仿学习的复合误差（Ross and Bagnell, 2010；Ross et al., 2011）。

sents.en: Predicting performance from scores on cheaper benchmarks ( Ruan et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2026 ) shares our goal but needs the target model’s scores, whereas our coordinates need neither scores nor environment runs.
sents.zh: 从更便宜的基准上的分数来预测性能（Ruan et al., 2024；Song et al., 2026）与我们的目标一致，但需要目标模型的分数，而我们的坐标既不需要分数也不需要环境运行。

paragraphs.en: Harness effects have been measured as changes in success rate by running every LLM–harness combination ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2026 ; Cho, 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) or decomposed into LLM and scaffold abilities with IRT ( Ge et al., 2026 ) ; we represent a component as a displacement on the map, obtained without running the composed agent, and ask whether displacements add (§ 4 ). Evaluations increasingly report consistency across trials, cost, and behaviors found in logs alongside success rates ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Kapoor et al., 2025 ; Kapoor et al., 2026 ) ; harnesses with similar success rates can differ greatly in token use and failure patterns ( Vats and Golev, 2026 ) , and agent behavior carries fingerprints of the underlying LLM ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Oderinwale, 2026 ; Lugoloobi et al., 2026 ) . All of these works run the agents and compare the resulting behavior through aggregate statistics or classifiers. We measure behavioral differences by distances obtained without running the agents, relate them to the trajectory KL with explicit error bounds (§ 2 ), and show that pairs at small distance behave alike when run (§ 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 框架效应已被测量为通过运行每个 LLM–框架组合（Zhang et al., 2026; Yao et al., 2026; Fan et al., 2026; Cho, 2026; Chen et al., 2026）得到的成功率变化，或通过 IRT 分解为 LLM 与脚手架能力（Ge et al., 2026）；我们则把一个组件表示为地图上的一个位移，该位移无需运行组合后的智能体即可获得，并询问位移是否可加（§ 4）。 评估越来越多地在报告成功率的同时报告跨多次试验的一致性、成本以及日志中发现的行为（Yao et al., 2025; Kapoor et al., 2025; Kapoor et al., 2026）；成功率相近的框架在 token 用量和失败模式上可能差异巨大（Vats and Golev, 2026），且智能体行为带有底层 LLM 的指纹（Sun et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2026; Oderinwale, 2026; Lugoloobi et al., 2026）。 所有这些工作都需要运行智能体，并通过聚合统计或分类器来比较所得到的行为。 我们通过无需运行智能体即可获得的距离来度量行为差异，将其与轨迹 KL 关联起来并给出明确的误差界（§ 2），并证明距离较小的智能体对在运行时表现相似（§ 3.3）。

sents.en: Harness effects have been measured as changes in success rate by running every LLM–harness combination ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2026 ; Cho, 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) or decomposed into LLM and scaffold abilities with IRT ( Ge et al., 2026 ) ; we represent a component as a displacement on the map, obtained without running the composed agent, and ask whether displacements add (§ 4 ).

sents.zh: 我们通过无需运行智能体即可获得的距离来度量行为差异，将其与轨迹 KL 关联起来并给出明确的误差界（§ 2），并证明距离较小的智能体对在运行时表现相似（§ 3.3）。

paragraphs.en: Agent Behavior Maps, obtained by teacher forcing on common reference trajectories, locate agents without running them. Their coordinates predict the success rates of models that were never run, on the benchmark the map was built from and, combined with size, in other environments. Neighbors on the map take similar action sequences when run. The theory decomposes the gap between the distances and the trajectory KL into four error sources and limits the guarantee to close pairs. Harness components appear as displacements within an LLM whose sums approximate the coordinates of unscored combinations, with an accuracy that depends on the component and the environment. The map represents not only a ranking by performance but also how close agents are in what they do.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体行为图通过对常见参考轨迹进行教师强制获得，无需实际运行智能体即可定位它们。 它们的坐标可以预测从未被运行过的模型的成功率，无论是在构建该图所用的基准上，还是结合模型规模在其他环境中。 图上相邻的智能体在被运行时采取相似的动作序列。 该理论将距离与轨迹 KL 之间的差距分解为四个误差来源，并将该保证限定于相近的智能体对。 框架组件表现为同一个 LLM 内的位移，其总和可近似未评分组合的坐标，其准确度取决于组件和环境。 该图不仅表示按性能的排名，还表示智能体在其行为上的接近程度。

sents.zh: 智能体行为图通过对常见参考轨迹进行教师强制获得，无需实际运行智能体即可定位它们。

sents.zh: 框架组件表现为同一个 LLM 内的位移，其总和可近似未评分组合的坐标，其准确度取决于组件和环境。

sents.zh: 该图不仅表示按性能的排名，还表示智能体在其行为上的接近程度。

paragraphs.en: Both the theoretical guarantee and the empirical correspondence are limited to close pairs. The KL can be read off the distance only for pairs in the local regime of small ε \varepsilon and λ \lambda , and pairs of different LLMs are not guaranteed to fall in it: the estimates exceed the measured KL by a median factor of 7.5, although their order agrees (§ 3.1 ). The correspondence with behavioral distance holds for neighbors and fades beyond about the 30th neighbor (Figure 1 (c)); we have not shown that the magnitude of the distance between far-apart pairs measures how different their behavior is. The map answers who is similar to whom, not by how much.
paragraphs.zh: 理论保证与实证对应关系都仅限于相近的智能体对。 只有在 ε \varepsilon 和 λ \lambda 都很小的局部区域内，才能从距离中读出 KL 散度，而不同大语言模型的智能体对并不保证落在这个区域内：估计值超出实测 KL 散度的中位数倍数为 7.5，尽管其排序是一致的（§ 3.1）。 与行为距离的对应关系对近邻智能体对成立，并在大约第 30 个近邻之外逐渐消失（图 1 (c)）；我们尚未证明相距较远的智能体对之间距离的大小能够衡量其行为差异的程度。 该映射回答的是谁与谁相似，而不是相似到什么程度。

paragraphs.en: Differences between policies in regions that Q Q never visits cannot be measured, and the reference mismatch λ \lambda remains a sensitivity parameter that the likelihood matrix alone does not determine. A general theory of the reference policy is left for future work.
paragraphs.zh: Q 永远不会访问的区域中策略之间的差异无法被测量，且参考失配 λ \lambda 仍然是一个仅凭似然矩阵无法确定的敏感性参数。 关于参考策略的一般性理论留待未来工作研究。

sents.zh: 关于参考策略的一般性理论留待未来工作研究。

paragraphs.en: The trajectory log-likelihood ratios in § 3.1 are based on the probability of the canonical token sequence and differ from action probabilities that marginalize over all tokenizations. In environments where the candidate set can be enumerated, this can be resolved by renormalization, but in general it is a limitation.
paragraphs.zh: § 3.1 中的轨迹对数似然比基于规范 token 序列的概率，与对所有可能 tokenization 进行边缘化所得的动作概率不同。 在候选集可以枚举的环境中，可以通过重新归一化来解决该问题，但一般情况下这是一个局限。

paragraphs.en: The coordinates require the target model’s log-likelihood of a given action sequence. Models that are available only through an API that does not return the log-probabilities of given text cannot be placed on the map, so this study is limited to open-weight models.
paragraphs.zh: 这些坐标需要目标模型对给定动作序列的对数似然。 仅通过不返回给定文本对数概率的 API 提供的模型无法被放置到地图上，因此本研究仅限于开放权重模型。

paragraphs.en: The behavioral comparisons are based on one rollout per task, and the behavior of the same model varies from run to run ( Bjarnason et al., 2026 ; Gonuguntla, 2026 ) . We have not compared the size of this variation with the behavioral distance to neighbors.
paragraphs.zh: 行为比较基于每个任务一次的 rollout，且同一模型的行为在每次运行之间会有所差异（Bjarnason et al., 2026；Gonuguntla, 2026）。 我们尚未将该变异幅度与相邻智能体之间的行为距离进行比较。

paragraphs.en: The harnesses in § 4 are limited to the 12 configurations of our own three-slot design (context management, planning, acting) and to 12 LLMs; the main additivity results are on τ \tau -bench, and ALFWorld and SWE-Bench cover 6 LLMs. Whether the same additivity holds for other scaffolds with differently designed components has not been tested.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4 节中的测试框架仅限于我们自己三槽设计（上下文管理、规划、行动）的 12 种配置以及 12 个大语言模型；主要的可加性结果来自 τ \tau -bench，而 ALFWorld 和 SWE-Bench 仅覆盖 6 个大语言模型。 对于采用不同组件设计的其他脚手架，同样的可加性是否成立尚未经过检验。

paragraphs.en: We define action probabilities under grammar-constrained decoding. A deployed agent can execute only outputs that match the environment’s action format, so its outputs are typically constrained to an action grammar, e.g., by constrained decoding. Our grammar constraint reflects this setting: the constrained policy is the distribution of actions the agent actually sends to the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在语法约束解码下定义动作概率。 部署的智能体只能执行符合环境动作格式的输出，因此其输出通常被约束到一个动作语法，例如通过约束解码实现。 我们的语法约束正反映了这一设定：受约束的策略即智能体实际发送给环境的动作分布。

sents.en: We define action probabilities under grammar-constrained decoding.
sents.zh: 我们在语法约束解码下定义动作概率。

paragraphs.en: The 100-model experiment scores without the grammar mask of Appendix A.1 . To check that this choice does not change the map, we use the scoring runs of ten LLMs (Qwen3-8B, Qwen3.8-27B, Qwen3.5-2B/9B, Gemma4-E4B/12B, GPT-OSS-20B, GLM-4.7-Flash, Devstral-Small-2-24B, Granite-3.3-2B) that recorded both the masked and the raw log-likelihood of each reference action. Six of them (Qwen3-8B, Qwen3.8-27B, Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-E4B, GPT-OSS-20B, GLM-4.7-Flash) share 3,412 reference steps with both scores. On these steps, the mask changes the mean log-likelihood per action by − 0.01 -0.01 to + 0.03 +0.03 nats, the per-step values correlate at r ≥ 0.99 r\geq 0.99 , and the pairwise squared distances between the six models correlate at 1.000 1.000 with the same ordering of all pairs, with and without centering. For each of the ten LLMs separately, we then replace its raw scores in the 100-model map by the masked scores on the steps where both exist (591–10,304 of the 10,388 steps, depending on the LLM). This moves its centered coordinate by 0.05 0.05 – 0.21 0.21 times the distance to its nearest neighbor (median 0.07 0.07 over the ten LLMs); the nearest neighbor is unchanged for all ten, the five nearest neighbors for nine (four of five for Granite-3.3-2B), and the rank correlation of the distances to the other 99 models is at least 0.997 0.997 .
paragraphs.zh: 附录 A.1 中的无语法掩码的 100 模型实验得分。 为验证这一选择不会改变该映射，我们使用了十个 LLM（Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.8-27B、Qwen3.5-2B/9B、Gemma4-E4B/12B、GPT-OSS-20B、GLM-4.7-Flash、Devstral-Small-2-24B、Granite-3.3-2B）的评分运行，这些运行同时记录了每个参考动作的掩码对数似然和原始对数似然。 其中六个（Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.8-27B、Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-E4B、GPT-OSS-20B、GLM-4.7-Flash）共享 3,412 个同时具有两种得分的参考步骤。 在这些步骤上，掩码使每个动作的平均对数似然变化 − 0.01 到 + 0.03 nats，逐步数值的相关性 r ≥ 0.99，并且六个模型之间的两两平方距离的相关性为 1.000，所有对在有无中心化的情况下排序一致。 然后对于这十个 LLM 中的每一个，我们分别将其在 100 模型映射中的原始得分替换为在两者都存在的步骤上的掩码得分（在 10,388 个步骤中占 591–10,304 个，取决于该 LLM）。 这使其中心化坐标移动了到其最近邻距离的 0.05–0.21 倍（十个 LLM 的中位数为 0.07）；对全部十个而言最近邻不变，九个的前五个最近邻不变（Granite-3.3-2B 为五个中的四个），并且与其他 99 个模型的距离的秩相关性至少为 0.997。

paragraphs.en: All likelihood computations and rollouts were run on ten NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs (96 GB each) served through vLLM. The complete set of experiments, including the scoring of 10,388 reference steps by 100 LLMs, the downstream rollouts of 100 LLMs on four benchmarks, and the 12 × 12 12\times 12 harness experiment, took approximately two weeks of wall-clock time on this cluster; we did not record per-experiment GPU hours. Each downstream task was run once per agent (Table 4 ), and the hyperparameters of the predictors are listed in Appendix B.3 and those of the harnesses in Appendix C.1 . Figure 1 (a) is a t-SNE layout ( van der Maaten and Hinton, 2008 ) of the centered coordinates with perplexity 15; all neighbors in the paper are computed in the original coordinate space. The τ \tau -bench and SWE-Bench reference trajectories are the publicly released HAL traces ( Kapoor et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Table 6 compares agreement with the KL with and without centering. On these eight models, centering gives a slightly higher correlation and a smaller RMSE. In performance prediction (Table 7 ), uncentered Ridge is about as good as or slightly better than centered Ridge, while for behavioral neighbors (Table 9 ) centering tends to give larger effects. Since neither choice wins on every measure, the main text reports centered coordinates throughout and the appendix also reports uncentered results.
paragraphs.zh: 表6比较了在有无中心化情况下与KL的一致性。 在这八个模型上，中心化带来了略高的相关系数和更小的RMSE。 在性能预测（表7）中，未中心化的Ridge与中心化的Ridge差不多好，或略好一些；而在行为近邻（表9）方面，中心化往往带来更大的效应。 由于两种选择在所有指标上都不占优，正文统一报告中心化坐标的结果，附录中也报告未中心化的结果。

paragraphs.en: The step version agrees better with the KL in both correlation and RMSE (Table 6 ). paragraphs.en: We hold out one model at a time and predict it from the remaining 99. kNN uses Euclidean distance in centered coordinates, and the number of neighbors k k is chosen from { 1 , 3 , 5 , 10 } \{1,3,5,10\} by inner leave-one-out on the 99 training models. Size plus coordinates is a Ridge regression with log 10 ⁡ | θ i | \log_{10}|\theta_{i}| as an unpenalized covariate. All hyperparameters are chosen by inner leave-one-out on the 99 training models, and predictions are clipped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . For differences from the size baseline, 95% intervals are the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 2,000 bootstrap resamples of models. We compute them for both the difference in Pearson r r , shown in bold in the main-text table, and the difference in RMSE, shown by arrows in the appendix table.

paragraphs.en: This section defines the action sequences, distances, neighbors, and tests of § 3.3 , and reports measures, controls, and robustness checks not shown in the main-text table.

paragraphs.en: We use one trajectory per model and task; run conditions are listed in Table 4 . For the 50 ALFWorld valid_unseen tasks, the trajectories come from the same runs as the performance labels. An action sequence is the sequence of commands for the 50 TextWorld treasure-hunter tasks, the sequence of function names extracted from model outputs for the 25 BFCL multi_turn tasks, and the sequence of action strings for the 50 MiniWoB++ tasks. The action type is the leading verb, function name, or tool name. An action is judged invalid by the environment’s set of admissible actions in ALFWorld, by the environment’s feedback that it could not parse the command in TextWorld, by a turn without a function call in BFCL, and by a tool error in MiniWoB++.

paragraphs.en: The four aspects in the main text are the base-2 Jensen–Shannon distance between action-type frequency distributions ( Endres and Schindelin, 2003 ) , the Levenshtein distance divided by the longer length ( Levenshtein, 1966 ; Rabanser et al., 2026 ) , the Jaccard distance between sets of action 2-grams, and the disagreement rate of the first action from the same initial state ( Bouchard and Chauhan, 2026 ; Gonuguntla, 2026 ) . The first three are computed per task and averaged over the tasks, at least 10, recorded for both models. The appendix tables add four more measures. The divergence position is 1 − k / min ⁡ ( T i , T j ) 1-k/\min(T_{i},T_{j}) , where k k is the number of steps before the first differing action. The conditional disagreement counts disagreement at step t t only for pairs whose action sequences agree up to step t − 1 t-1 , summed over t = 2 , … , 5 t=2,\dots,5 ; only pairs with at least 10 such cases are used. For the first action, conditional disagreement, and divergence position, two invalid actions are not counted as agreeing. The profile distance is the Euclidean distance between per-model vectors standardized within each benchmark; each vector contains task averages of the repetition rate T − | distinct actions | T − 1 \frac{T-|\text{distinct actions}|}{T-1} ( Gioacchini et al., 2024 ) , the consecutive repetition rate, exploration breadth measured as distinct actions / T /T , the invalid-action rate, which is the complement of grounding accuracy ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , the share of information-gathering actions, the format-error rate, steps / / limit, the rate of hitting the step limit, and the early-termination rate. For BFCL we also include the rate of empty turns. The success pattern is the fraction of tasks on which the two models’ outcomes differ, 1 | 𝒯 | ​ ∑ t | s i ​ t − s j ​ t | \frac{1}{|\mathcal{T}|}\sum_{t}\lvert s_{it}-s_{jt}\rvert .
paragraphs.zh: 正文中的四个方面是动作类型频率分布之间的以2为底的Jensen–Shannon距离（Endres and Schindelin, 2003）、Levenshtein距离除以较长序列的长度（Levenshtein, 1966; Rabanser et al., 2026）、动作2-gram集合之间的Jaccard距离，以及来自相同初始状态的第一个动作的不一致率（Bouchard and Chauhan, 2026; Gonuguntla, 2026）。 前三项按任务逐一计算，并在两个模型各自记录的至少10个任务上取平均值。 附录表格增加了四项更多的度量。 分歧位置为 1 − k / min ⁡ ( T i , T j ) 1-k/\min(T_{i},T_{j})，其中 k k 是首个不同动作出现之前的步数。 条件性不一致只统计在第 t t 步出现不一致且其动作序列在第 t − 1 t-1 步之前都一致的配对，并对 t = 2 , … , 5 t=2,\dots,5 求和；仅使用满足此类情形至少10个的配对。 对于第一个动作、条件性不一致和分歧位置，两个无效动作不计为一致。 剖面距离是在每个基准内标准化后的各模型向量之间的欧氏距离；每个向量包含以下各项的任务平均值：重复率 T − | distinct actions | T − 1 \frac{T-|\text{distinct actions}|}{T-1}（Gioacchini et al., 2024）、连续重复率、以 distinct actions / T /T 度量的探索广度、无效动作率（即接地准确率的补数）（Ma et al., 2024）、信息收集动作占比、格式错误率、steps / / limit、触达步数上限的比率以及提前终止率。 对于BFCL，我们还纳入了空轮次的比率。 成功模式是两个模型结果不同的任务所占的比例，即 1 | 𝒯 | ​ ∑ t | s i ​ t − s j ​ t | \frac{1}{|\mathcal{T}|}\sum_{t}\lvert s_{it}-s_{jt}\rvert。

sents.en: The four aspects in the main text are the base-2 Jensen–Shannon distance between action-type frequency distributions ( Endres and Schindelin, 2003 ) , the Levenshtein distance divided by the longer length ( Levenshtein, 1966 ; Rabanser et al., 2026 ) , the Jaccard distance between sets of action 2-grams, and the disagreement rate of the first action from the same initial state ( Bouchard and Chauhan, 2026 ; Gonuguntla, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 正文中的四个方面是动作类型频率分布之间的以2为底的Jensen–Shannon距离（Endres and Schindelin, 2003）、Levenshtein距离除以较长序列的长度（Levenshtein, 1966; Rabanser et al., 2026）、动作2-gram集合之间的Jaccard距离，以及来自相同初始状态的第一个动作的不一致率（Bouchard and Chauhan, 2026; Gonuguntla, 2026）。

sents.en: The first three are computed per task and averaged over the tasks, at least 10, recorded for both models.
sents.zh: 前三项按任务逐一计算，并在两个模型各自记录的至少10个任务上取平均值。

sents.en: The appendix tables add four more measures.
sents.zh: 附录表格增加了四项更多的度量。

sents.en: The divergence position is 1 − k / min ⁡ ( T i , T j ) 1-k/\min(T_{i},T_{j}) , where k k is the number of steps before the first differing action.
sents.zh: 分歧位置为 1 − k / min ⁡ ( T i , T j ) 1-k/\min(T_{i},T_{j})，其中 k k 是首个不同动作出现之前的步数。

sents.en: The conditional disagreement counts disagreement at step t t only for pairs whose action sequences agree up to step t − 1 t-1 , summed over t = 2 , … , 5 t=2,\dots,5 ; only pairs with at least 10 such cases are used.
sents.zh: 条件性不一致只统计在第 t t 步出现不一致且其动作序列在第 t − 1 t-1 步之前都一致的配对，并对 t = 2 , … , 5 t=2,\dots,5 求和；仅使用满足此类情形至少10个的配对。

sents.en: For the first action, conditional disagreement, and divergence position, two invalid actions are not counted as agreeing.
sents.zh: 对于第一个动作、条件性不一致和分歧位置，两个无效动作不计为一致。

sents.en: The profile distance is the Euclidean distance between per-model vectors standardized within each benchmark; each vector contains task averages of the repetition rate T − | distinct actions | T − 1 \frac{T-|\text{distinct actions}|}{T-1} ( Gioacchini et al., 2024 ) , the consecutive repetition rate, exploration breadth measured as distinct actions / T /T , the invalid-action rate, which is the complement of grounding accuracy ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , the share of information-gathering actions, the format-error rate, steps / / limit, the rate of hitting the step limit, and the early-termination rate.
sents.zh: 剖面距离是在每个基准内标准化后的各模型向量之间的欧氏距离；每个向量包含以下各项的任务平均值：重复率 T − | distinct actions | T − 1 \frac{T-|\text{distinct actions}|}{T-1}（Gioacchini et al., 2024）、连续重复率、以 distinct actions / T /T 度量的探索广度、无效动作率（即接地准确率的补数）（Ma et al., 2024）、信息收集动作占比、格式错误率、steps / / limit、触达步数上限的比率以及提前终止率。

sents.en: For BFCL we also include the rate of empty turns.
sents.zh: 对于BFCL，我们还纳入了空轮次的比率。

sents.en: The success pattern is the fraction of tasks on which the two models’ outcomes differ, 1 | 𝒯 | ​ ∑ t | s i ​ t − s j ​ t | \frac{1}{|\mathcal{T}|}\sum_{t}\lvert s_{it}-s_{jt}\rvert .
sents.zh: 成功模式是两个模型结果不同的任务所占的比例，即 1 | 𝒯 | ​ ∑ t | s i ​ t − s j ​ t | \frac{1}{|\mathcal{T}|}\sum_{t}\lvert s_{it}-s_{jt}\rvert。

paragraphs.en: Each model’s five neighbors are the closest models in centered coordinates by Euclidean distance, in size by the difference in log ⁡ | θ | \log|\theta| , in ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell} by the difference in mean log-likelihood on the reference trajectories, in family by taking models of the same family in order of size, and in success rate by the difference in measured success rate on that benchmark. For families with fewer than five other members, the remaining neighbors are taken from other families in order of size. The effect size is the mean behavioral distance to the remaining models minus the mean distance to the five neighbors, averaged over models and divided by the standard deviation of the behavioral distance over all pairs. Figure 1 (c) applies the same definition to the k k -th nearest model alone; ranks k ≤ 5 k\leq 5 are shown individually and larger ranks as bin averages. Significance is assessed by a two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test ( Wilcoxon, 1945 ) paired by model. The comparison between coordinate neighbors and success-rate neighbors, marked † \dagger in the main-text table, uses the same paired test: it asks whether the distance to success-rate neighbors minus the distance to coordinate neighbors, divided by the all-pairs standard deviation, is positive. These are paired tests with models as the unit; pairs share models and no correction for multiple comparisons is applied, so the significance markers are descriptive guides rather than exact error rates. The main conclusions rest on effects that are large (at least 0.5 0.5 for coordinate neighbors in ALFWorld) and consistent across measures rather than on individual markers; small differences marked as significant, such as those between coordinate and success-rate neighbors in the other environments, should be read as suggestive.
paragraphs.zh: 每个模型的五个邻居分别是：在中心化坐标下按欧氏距离最近的模型，在规模上按 log ⁡ | θ | \log|\theta| 之差最近的模型，在 ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell} 上按参考轨迹平均对数似然之差最近的模型，在家族上按规模顺序取同一家族的模型，以及在成功率上按该基准上实测成功率之差最近的模型。 对于成员少于五个的其他家族，其余邻居按规模顺序取自其他家族。 效应量定义为到其余模型的平均行为距离减去到五个邻居的平均距离，对所有模型取平均后再除以所有模型对上行为距离的标准差。 图 1 (c) 将同样的定义单独应用于第 k k 近的模型；rank k ≤ 5 k\leq 5 逐一显示，更大的 rank 以分箱平均值显示。 显著性通过按模型配对的双侧 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验（ Wilcoxon, 1945 ）来评估。 坐标邻居与成功率邻居之间的比较（正文表格中以 † \dagger 标出）使用同样的配对检验：它检验的是到成功率邻居的距离减去到坐标邻居的距离、再除以所有模型对标准差之后是否为正。 这些是以模型为单位的配对检验；各配对共享模型且未做多重比较校正，因此显著性标记只是描述性指引，而非精确的错误率。 主要结论依赖于效应量大（坐标邻居在 ALFWorld 中至少为 0.5 0.5 ）且在各度量上一致的结果，而非单个标记；被标为显著的小差异，例如其他环境中坐标邻居与成功率邻居之间的差异，应视为提示性结果。

paragraphs.en: The main conclusion is that coordinate neighbors behave alike when run. We check that this does not depend on the choice of behavioral distance, on how performance is controlled, or on how the coordinates are built.
paragraphs.zh: 主要结论是：坐标邻近的智能体在运行时表现相似。 我们检验了这一结论不依赖于行为距离的选择、性能的控制方式，或坐标的构建方式。

paragraphs.en: Part A of Table 8 adds the divergence position, conditional disagreement, profile, and success pattern to the four distances of the main text. The divergence position and conditional disagreement, which measure divergence early in the episode, follow the same pattern as the first action. For the profile, which aggregates repetition and invalid-action rates, and for the success pattern, neighbors chosen by success rate are closer than coordinate neighbors. These measures reflect how often an agent fails and are therefore tied closely to its success rate.
paragraphs.zh: 表8的A部分在正文四个距离的基础上加入了分歧位置、条件不一致、行为画像和成功模式。 分歧位置和条件不一致衡量情节早期的分歧，与第一个动作呈现相同的模式。 对于汇总重复率和无效动作率的行为画像，以及成功模式，按成功率选取的邻居比坐标邻居更近。 这些指标反映智能体失败的频率，因此与其成功率密切相关。

sents.en: Part A of Table 8 adds the divergence position, conditional disagreement, profile, and success pattern to the four distances of the main text.
sents.zh: 表8的A部分在正文四个距离的基础上加入了分歧位置、条件不一致、行为画像和成功模式。

sents.zh: 分歧位置和条件不一致衡量情节早期的分歧，与第一个动作呈现相同的模式。

sents.zh: 对于汇总重复率和无效动作率的行为画像，以及成功模式，按成功率选取的邻居比坐标邻居更近。

sents.zh: 这些指标反映智能体失败的频率，因此与其成功率密切相关。

paragraphs.en: Instead of comparing with neighbors chosen by success rate, part B of Table 8 removes the effect of performance by regression. We regress each behavioral distance on the difference in success rate, the pair’s mean success rate and its square, and the difference in log ⁡ | θ | \log|\theta| , and compute the effect of coordinate neighbors on the residuals. We control for the mean success rate as well because strong models converge on the shortest solutions and therefore act alike. For the success pattern, we instead subtract its expectation under a null distribution generated by the curveball algorithm ( Strona et al., 2014 ) , which shuffles outcomes while keeping each model’s success rate and each task’s difficulty fixed. After this control, the effect of coordinate neighbors remains on every aspect in ALFWorld, the environment of the coordinates, and mainly on the local and early-step measures in the other environments.
paragraphs.zh: 表 8 的 B 部分不再与按成功率选取的邻居进行比较，而是通过回归去除表现的影响。 我们将每个行为距离对成功率的差异、该模型对的平均成功率及其平方，以及 log ⁡ | θ | \log|\theta| 的差异进行回归，并计算坐标邻居对残差的影响。 我们还控制平均成功率，因为强大的模型会收敛到最短的解，因此行为相似。 对于成功模式，我们改为减去其在由 curveball 算法（Strona et al., 2014）生成的零分布下的期望，该算法在保持每个模型的成功率和每个任务难度不变的情况下打乱结果。 经过这一控制后，坐标邻居的影响在坐标所在的环境 ALFWorld 的各个方面仍然存在，而在其他环境中主要体现在局部和早期步骤的度量上。

paragraphs.en: The top half of Table 9 chooses neighbors in uncentered coordinates. The effect is weaker than with centered coordinates, presumably because the overall likelihood level then influences which models count as neighbors. The bottom half excludes models of the same family from the coordinate neighbors. The effect remains on all four benchmarks, so coordinate neighbors do not behave alike merely because they belong to the same family.
paragraphs.zh: 表9的上半部分在未中心化的坐标中选择邻居。 该效应弱于中心化坐标下的结果，可能是因为此时整体似然水平会影响哪些模型被视为邻居。 表9的下半部分将同一家族的模型从坐标邻居中排除。 该效应在全部四个基准上依然存在，因此坐标邻居表现相似并非仅仅因为它们属于同一家族。

paragraphs.en: The input is assembled in the order fixed part, history selected by context management, plan and reasoning for the current step, and action instruction. The fixed part consists of the system instructions, tool definitions, and initial observation (including the task instruction) and is shared by all harnesses. One block of the external history is an executed action and the resulting observation; past plans and reasoning are not included. The budget for the history part is 8,192 tokens, and the whole input is at most 16,384 tokens including the reserve for the output; when the budget is exceeded, the oldest blocks are dropped first and, if necessary, the latest observation is truncated to its head and tail.
paragraphs.zh: 输入按以下顺序组装：固定部分、由上下文管理选出的历史、当前步骤的计划与推理，以及动作指令。 固定部分由系统指令、工具定义和初始观察（包括任务指令）组成，并为所有 harness 共享。 外部历史的一个块是一次已执行的动作及其得到的观察；过去的计划和推理不包含在内。 历史部分的预算为 8,192 个 token，整个输入（包括为输出保留的部分）最多为 16,384 个 token；当超出预算时，最先丢弃最旧的块，必要时将最新的观察截断为其开头和结尾部分。

sents.en: The input is assembled in the order fixed part, history selected by context management, plan and reasoning for the current step, and action instruction.
sents.zh: 输入按以下顺序组装：固定部分、由上下文管理选出的历史、当前步骤的计划与推理，以及动作指令。

sents.en: The fixed part consists of the system instructions, tool definitions, and initial observation (including the task instruction) and is shared by all harnesses.
sents.zh: 固定部分由系统指令、工具定义和初始观察（包括任务指令）组成，并为所有 harness 共享。

sents.en: One block of the external history is an executed action and the resulting observation; past plans and reasoning are not included.
sents.zh: 外部历史的一个块是一次已执行的动作及其得到的观察；过去的计划和推理不包含在内。

sents.en: The budget for the history part is 8,192 tokens, and the whole input is at most 16,384 tokens including the reserve for the output; when the budget is exceeded, the oldest blocks are dropped first and, if necessary, the latest observation is truncated to its head and tail.
sents.zh: 历史部分的预算为 8,192 个 token，整个输入（包括为输出保留的部分）最多为 16,384 个 token；当超出预算时，最先丢弃最旧的块，必要时将最新的观察截断为其开头和结尾部分。

paragraphs.en: Context management : windowed passes the initial observation and the last four blocks verbatim. retrieve additionally selects, from the older history, blocks relevant to the current observation by BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) (weight 0.7) and recency (0.3) and inserts up to 1,536 tokens of them. summarize splits the older history, summarizes the parts, and merges them hierarchically into a JSON memory of at most 1,024 tokens that replaces the history. If the history has at most four blocks and uses at most 75% of the budget, neither retrieval nor summarization is applied and the history is passed raw.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文管理：windowed 逐字传递初始观察和最后四个区块。retrieve 额外从较早的历史中，通过 BM25（Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009）（权重 0.7）和近因性（0.3）选出与当前观察相关的区块，并插入其中最多 1,536 个 token。summarize 将较早的历史拆分，对各部分进行总结，并分层合并为一个最多 1,024 个 token 的 JSON 记忆，用以替换该历史。 如果历史最多只有四个区块且最多使用 75% 的预算，则既不应用检索也不应用总结，历史将原样传递。

sents.en: Context management : windowed passes the initial observation and the last four blocks verbatim. retrieve additionally selects, from the older history, blocks relevant to the current observation by BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) (weight 0.7) and recency (0.3) and inserts up to 1,536 tokens of them. summarize splits the older history, summarizes the parts, and merges them hierarchically into a JSON memory of at most 1,024 tokens that replaces the history.
sents.zh: 上下文管理：windowed 逐字传递初始观察和最后四个区块。retrieve 额外从较早的历史中，通过 BM25（Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009）（权重 0.7）和近因性（0.3）选出与当前观察相关的区块，并插入其中最多 1,536 个 token。summarize 将较早的历史拆分，对各部分进行总结，并分层合并为一个最多 1,024 个 token 的 JSON 记忆，用以替换该历史。

sents.en: If the history has at most four blocks and uses at most 75% of the budget, neither retrieval nor summarization is applied and the history is passed raw.
sents.zh: 如果历史最多只有四个区块且最多使用 75% 的预算，则既不应用检索也不应用总结，历史将原样传递。

paragraphs.en: Planning : replan rewrites from scratch, at every step and in at most 256 tokens, the confirmed progress, the next subgoal, and the observation that would confirm its achievement, and adds them to the input of the current step.
paragraphs.zh: 规划：重新规划在每一步、且至多 256 个 token 内，从头重写已确认的进展、下一个子目标，以及能确认其达成的观察结果，并将它们添加到当前步骤的输入中。

paragraphs.en: Acting : think generates, for the next single action, step-by-step reasoning of at most 512 tokens that organizes the goal, constraints, assumptions, and expected effect of the action, and adds it to the input of the current step (the plan, if any, is also included in the input).
paragraphs.zh: 行动：think 为下一个单一动作生成最多 512 个 token 的逐步推理，整理该动作的目标、约束、假设和预期效果，并将其添加到当前步骤的输入中（计划（如果有的话）也包含在输入中）。

paragraphs.en: Plans and reasoning are not carried over to the next step.
paragraphs.zh: 计划与推理不会延续到下一步。

paragraphs.en: Generation (rollouts) and scoring (teacher forcing) use the same construction; for scoring, each harness builds its input from the same reference history h t h_{t} , and the raw log-likelihood of the fixed reference action is computed. The action being scored, future observations, and rewards are not used in the input.
paragraphs.zh: 生成（rollout）与评分（教师强制）使用相同的构造；在评分时，每个 harness 都基于相同的参考历史 h t h_{t} 构建其输入，并计算固定参考动作的原始对数似然。 被评分的动作、未来的观测和奖励都不会用于输入。

sents.en: Generation (rollouts) and scoring (teacher forcing) use the same construction; for scoring, each harness builds its input from the same reference history h t h_{t} , and the raw log-likelihood of the fixed reference action is computed.
sents.zh: 生成（rollout）与评分（教师强制）使用相同的构造；在评分时，每个 harness 都基于相同的参考历史 h t h_{t} 构建其输入，并计算固定参考动作的原始对数似然。

sents.en: The action being scored, future observations, and rewards are not used in the input.

paragraphs.en: The 12 LLMs are Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) , Qwen3.5-27B/9B/2B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) , Gemma4-E4B/12B/31B ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) , GPT-OSS-20B/120B ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , GLM-4.7-Flash ( Z.ai, 2026 ) , and Devstral-Small-2-24B ( Rastogi et al., 2025 ) , all among the 100 models of § 3.2 . SWE-Bench was scored with 6 of them (Qwen3-8B, Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma4-E4B, GPT-OSS-20B/120B, GLM-4.7-Flash).

paragraphs.en: τ \tau -bench: 359 HAL ( Kapoor et al., 2026 ) airline traces mapped to the 30 tasks of the train split of τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench ( Barres et al., 2026 ) ; of their 4,236 steps, the 4,213 scored by all 144 agents are used for the coordinates. SWE-Bench: 100 HAL traces of SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , 3,916 steps. paragraphs.en: Table 12 and Figure 5 give the full results. On ALFWorld and SWE-Bench (6 LLMs) the direction of the composed displacement also agrees with the prediction, but more weakly than on τ \tau -bench (median cosines over all LLMs × \times 5 two-component compositions of 0.63 0.63 and 0.81 0.81 ), and on ALFWorld the relative reconstruction error reaches about 1. Each column is a median of per-LLM values, so the columns do not satisfy the identity below exactly. The ALFWorld reference trajectories are rollouts of the agents under study themselves, and only 2,299 of their steps are scored by all 72 agents.
paragraphs.zh: 表12和图5给出了完整结果。 在ALFWorld和SWE-Bench（6个LLM）上，合成位移的方向也与预测一致，但弱于τ \tau -bench（所有LLM × \times 5种双组分组合的中位余弦值分别为0.63 0.63和0.81 0.81），并且在ALFWorld上，相对重构误差达到约1。 每一列是各LLM数值的中位数，因此各列并不完全满足下方的恒等式。 ALFWorld的参考轨迹是所研究智能体自身的推演结果，且其步骤中仅有2,299步被全部72个智能体评分。
